calculation_formula.description: Rata-rata total nilai CPL dihitung berdasarkan pembobotan porsi 4 kategori CPL

key_features_implementation.login_page: Simple academic credential authentication with UINSA dark green header, university emblem preview, quick demo credentials button for testing
key_features_implementation.dashboard: Combined visual analytics featuring KPI summary cards, Bar Chart (CPL per Kategori), Pie Chart (Distribusi Kelulusan / Pencapaian), and Radar Chart (Spider Web chart comparing 12 CPL criteria)
key_features_implementation.input_form: Batch and individual input form for course scores with dropdown filters for Semester (Ganjil/Genap), Tahun Akademik (e.g. 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025), Fakultas, Prodi, Mata Kuliah, Kelas (A-D), and Semester (I-VIII). Dynamic 12 CPL inputs with automatic weighted calculation preview
key_features_implementation.mata_kuliah_crud: Management page to add/edit/delete courses grouped by Fakultas & Prodi with CPL criteria assignment options
key_features_implementation.fakultas_prodi_crud: Management page to add/edit/delete Fakultas (e.g., Fakultas Sains dan Teknologi, Fakultas Tarbiyah dan Keguruan) and Program Studi (e.g., Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Pendidikan Agama Islam)
key_features_implementation.reports_and_export: Comprehensive report page with print browser optimization (@media print styling) and PDF export capability per Tahun Akademik, Mata Kuliah, and CPL criteria
key_features_implementation.toast_notifications: Use Sonner toast notifications for all save/update/delete/export actions

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files exclusively. Do NOT create TypeScript (.tsx) files.
Follow the white, dark green (#064E3B), gold (#D97706 / #F59E0B), and black palette strictly.
Display the UINSA logo in the header and login screen prominently using the provided asset URL.
Ensure all 12 CPL criteria and the 4 categories (Sikap 20%, Pengetahuan 10%, Keterampilan Umum 30%, Keterampilan Khusus 40%) are clearly rendered and calculated with 2 decimal precision.
Support both browser window print (@media print) and PDF export for reports.
Add test attributes data-testid to every interactive form field, filter, button, tab, and table row.
